vb_textbox.text: if you select a red, purple, pink or brown gnome - you will get a red basket. if you select a yellow, orange, blue, green gnome - you will get a yellow basket. try and stick to the same colour until the basket starts giving you low numbers. when this happens switch to the other colour. after switching colours the number in the basket should go higher. if not then switch back to your starting colour e.g. red -> yellow -> red
